```python
from flask import Flask

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route("/")
def hello():
    return "Hello, World!", 200

# Test the route in-process
with app.test_client() as client:
    response = client.get("/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    print(f"✓ GET / returned status {response.status_code}")
```
